# Dr. Ali Hassan Health & Wellness

> Official information hub for BrainAxis supplements and the founder, Dr. Muhammad Ali Hassan. Website for customers in Pakistan. Product information is not a substitute for personal medical advice.

Canonical website: https://draliwellness.com/
Language: English (Pakistan)
Brand: BrainAxis

## Key pages
- [Home](https://draliwellness.com/): Overview of BrainAxis supplement products and services.
- [Shop](https://draliwellness.com/shop/): Available products and customer ordering.
- [Energy Boost](https://draliwellness.com/product/brainaxis-energy-boost/): 30-tablet multivitamin/mineral supplement, pack label, directions and precautions.
- [SUNDEX-D](https://draliwellness.com/product/brainaxis-sundex-d/): Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) 200,000 IU high-dose softgel. Use only under qualified clinical guidance; not a routine daily vitamin dose.
- [About Dr. Muhammad Ali Hassan](https://draliwellness.com/about/): Founder background and company vision.
- [Services](https://draliwellness.com/services/): Wellness and consultation availability, including coming-soon services.
- [FAQ](https://draliwellness.com/faq/): Product, support, safety and ordering questions.
- [Contact](https://draliwellness.com/contact/): Customer support and enquiries.
